messages:
aj: Quick check — Quincy region (quincy-us-east-2) cutover scheduled next Wed. Need final owners for DNS, egress policy, KMS handoff, and peering. TL;DR: infra -> @lina, network/BGP -> @samir?, legal/compliance -> @maria. Can everyone confirm blockers?

lina: I can own infra: proxy + canary config + compute pools. Will raise the canary PR today.

samir: I can take BGP/egress ACLs. Need the exact IP blocks from cloud team and confirmation on fallback policy. Also need a peering account.

aj: IP list (copy for tickets):
```
DNS: quincy-api.redwood-inference.com -> 10.6.0.0/22
proxy VIP: 10.6.0.10
KMS endpoints: kms.quincy.redwood-inference.com
```
Can someone paste this into the peering ticket?

maria: Legal/compliance ack in principle. If customers request EU-only keys we need Private option; otherwise region KMS is ok. Filing export-control check, will update by EOD Tue.

devex-bot: Reminder: add the region canary template to /templates/region-canary.yml and tag devex-review.

samir: Opening a ticket with cloud provider now. @tony can you confirm peering account and add attachments?

tony: On it — creating ticket PEER-789 and adding required org docs. Link: https://tickets/internal/PEER-789

lina: Canary test plan (short):
1) route 1% traffic to quincy
2) monitor 99p latency + token error rate
3) auto-rollback if error rate > 0.5% for 5m
PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/342 (canary config)

aj: Please ack owners by EOD. Also need a quick CR for firewall rule ordering — @lina pls ping @samir (PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/355).

maria: :thumbsup: ack from legal. Will attach a short compliance note for customers in APAC.

samir: Ack egress/BGP. Firewall PR looks fine but I'll comment on ACL order (deny-before-allow fix).

lina: Added devex-review tag to PR and updated canary YAML per checklist. @ops-bot please schedule the smoke run.

ops-bot: Scheduled: quincy-canary-smoke — Wed 03:00 UTC. Oncall notified.

aj: If no blockers, target to close region-task by Fri. I will follow up in daily standups.

devex-bot: Checklist state: [x] canary template added, [ ] DNS entries in infra-params, [ ] peering ticket created, [ ] KMS CA confirmed. Marking thread: action-req.

samir: One more item — confirm egress fallback to us-east-1 for capacity spikes. @aj pls confirm policy.

aj: Confirmed: fallback to us-east-1 allowed for this rollout. I'll add note to runbook.

tony: Adding runbook link: https://wiki/internal/quincy-rollout (will attach step-by-step ops tasks).

lina: :white_check_mark: infra ready to start config push tomorrow morning.

ops-bot: Oncall rota pinged: @ovi @sara.

aj: Closing loop — owners confirmed, tickets created, canary scheduled. If anything new pops up, reopen this thread. :party-parrot:
